title: NASA-UAP-D019, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part I, 1965

pages.description: A very wide, short image consisting almost entirely of a pale cream or off-white background with faint tonal variations. There are subtle lighter and slightly darker streaks across the surface, suggesting a blank or nearly blank scanned paper. No text, figures, or distinct objects are visible.

observations.claim: The image is predominantly a uniform off-white or cream color.
No legible text is present in the image.
Faint tonal streaks are visible across the surface.
The image has a very wide and short aspect ratio.

pages.description: The image is almost entirely white with no discernible content. Faint, very light beige or off-white lines are barely visible near the top and along the right edge, suggesting the faint outline of a border or box, but no text, figures, or distinct objects are present.

observations.claim: Faint light-colored lines appear near the top and right edges
